calls.video_title: A Once in a 100 Year Investment Opportunity Just Started (Felix Nikolas Prehn on Where He's Buying)
calls.thesis: BUY — first tracked. Emerson Electric is the cleanest power/electrification play: the US needs far more electricity whatever happens to AI data-centre buildout, and EMR is profitable and reputable.
calls.base_case: Electricity demand grows regardless of AI; EMR is the cleanest way to own it.
calls.bull_case: US energy infrastructure catch-up accelerates EMR's growth.
calls.bear_case: AI buildout scales back sharply and electrification spending slows.
